name: multi-pipeline-dora-consolidator
description: Computes the DORA four keys as one unified org-level and per-team view across teams shipping through GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, and Azure DevOps, normalizing event definitions across providers so a mixed-CI organization sees comparable numbers. Differs from single-tool DORA agents by consolidating across VCS and CI providers. Read-only.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on FRI at 07:00 UTC
